description: This file contains functions for CSV serialization and deserialization of recordsets, including reading/writing CSV files, handling recordset serialization, and managing file locks. It is part of the ADODB library for database abstraction in PHP.

methods.name: _rs2serialize
methods.description: Converts a recordset into a serialized CSV format, including metadata and data rows.

methods.name: csv2rs
methods.description: Reads a CSV file or URL and converts it into a recordset object, handling metadata, serialization, and timeouts.

methods.name: adodb_write_file
methods.description: Writes contents to a file with file locking or atomic rename, handling cross-platform issues.
